title: ranunculus diversifolius proles triphyllus
intro: Ranunculus diversifolius proles triphyllus, commonly known as the lesser celandine, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). The lesser celandine has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The plant's therapeutic actions also include antispasmodic and anti-anxiety properties, making it a potential treatment for digestive issues and anxiety disorders. Bioactive constituents of the lesser celandine include isopimpinellin, imperatorin, and bergapten, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
